minutes_text:
MINUTES
  ENVIRONMENTAL ADVISORY COMMITTEE
  NOVEMBER 7, 2018

1.  CALL TO ORDER

  CHAIR ZUCKERMAN called the meeting to order at 7:00 p.m.

2.  ROLL CALL

  COMMITTEE MEMBERS PRESENT:  Chair Zuckerman, Retz, Chan-Southwell,
  Radocchio, Stegura, Warner

  COMMITTEE MEMBERS ABSENT:  Larson, Vona (Ex Officio), Schachter

  STAFF PRESENT:  Assistant to the City Manager Davis
  Sr. Planner Naughton
  Administrative Assistant Corea

3.  APPROVAL OF MINUTES

A.  APPROVAL OF ENVIRONMENTAL ADVISORY COMMITTEE MINUTES, SEPTEMBER
  18, 2018

  A motion was made to approve the corrected Environmental Advisory Committee Minutes
  of September 18, 2018.

  There being no objection, CHAIR ZUCKERMAN so ordered.

4.  AUDIENCE ITEMS

  None

5.  DISCUSSION ITEMS

A.  PARTICIPATION IN ELECTRIFY AMERICA

  Assistant to the City Manager Davis provided background information on the Electrify
  America program, which would provide installation of Electrical Vehicle (EV) charging
  stations at work sites and high density commercial locations within a minimum distance
  from each other. When looking into the requirements, staff determined that the city work
  sites would not qualify, however, other sites discussed would – one being the Palos
  Verdes Library. Assistant to the City Manager Davis explained the two options for charging
  stations as well as the timeline for this program. Some of the sites that have been
  discussed are, the PV Library for Level 2, and Peninsula Center for a DC fast charging
  station.
   After further discussion, the Committee agreed that the following sites be considered for
  the Electrify America Program:

    Palos Verdes Library
    The Village parking deck
    Peninsula Center
    Additional commercial/business buildings also to be considered

B.  CPA NON-RESIDENTIAL DEFAULT RATE TIER

  CHAIR ZUCKERMAN stated that a decision on a recommendation will be further
  discussed at a future meeting since the deadline has been moved to February 2019.
  CHAIR ZUCKERMAN provided information on the latest developments with rates and how
  customers will be affected. A brief discussion was held regarding the various default rates.

6.  COMMITTEE REPORTS

  None

7.  COMMITTEE ITEMS/FUTURE AGENDA ITEMS

  Sr. Planner Naughton provided information on a notice that came to staff’s attention
  regarding the U.S. Navy’s proposal to renew fueling operations at a decommissioned
  facility in San Pedro. The Committee and staff agreed to provide comments on the scoping
  phase of the Draft Environmental Assessment for the proposed project. Comments are
  due on November 13, 2018.

8.  ADJOURNMENT

  CHAIR ZUCKERMAN adjourned the meeting at 7:51 p.m., the next Environmental
  Advisory Committee has tentatively been scheduled for January 15, 2019 at 7:00 p.m.
